summary: Written by the data agent at build time, pending a real judge. Corolla, Civic, Camry, the F-150 and the Beetle come fast; Passat, Hilux and Fiesta are the 'oh right' ones, and the Model T and Mustang miss the cut.
reasons: Casual found 7 (Corolla, Civic, F-150, Camry, Beetle, Accord, Golf) and lost lives on the Mustang, Model T, Prius and Wrangler, each showing its units sold.
Named by model ("Corolla"), so a bare brand ("toyota", "honda") never offers the top 10; "toyota corolla", "f150", "vw beetle" all work.
The page lists each brand's best seller only: RAV4, Model 3, Silverado and Focus are free. Blitz: 15 of 23 casual names scored.
